head_commit.message:
fix(tui): avoid stale status refresh notice

Stop rendering transient rate-limit refresh text into `/status` history.
Those lines are flattened into terminal scrollback, so later async refresh
completion cannot update them in place.

Keep the refresh request so future `/status` output can use updated cached
limits, and adjust focused tests to cover that behavior.
